Kept `staticPodPath` validation in a separate `validateStaticPodPathForPool` rather than adding it to `validateUserKubeletConfig` because `validateUserKubeletConfig` is called once per CR before pools are resolved and doesn't have pool context. Since `staticPodPath` needs pool awareness (allowed for workers, blocked for control plane), the check lives in the per-pool processing loop alongside an `isControlPlanePool()` helper that detects control plane pools by name (master/arbiter) and by NodeSelector. Open to folding it into `validateUserKubeletConfig` if preferred, it would mean moving that call into the per-pool loop and re-running the pool-independent checks per pool.

The two failing required jobs are unrelated to this change — each failed run has a distinct infra/flake cause, with no signal pointing at the kubelet-config validation changes in this PR:

**[e2e-aws-ovn-upgrade (latest run)](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/view/gs/prow-artifact-archive/pr-logs/pull/openshift_machine-config-operator/5724/pull-ci-openshift-machine-config-operator-main-e2e-aws-ovn-upgrade/2074845669683630080)** — infra failure before any tests ran. The job died in the `ipi-conf` phase with the CI pod stuck unschedulable (`0/50 nodes are available: 41 node(s) had untolerated taint(s)`, final state `pod_pending`); the test cluster was never provisioned and no kubeconfig existed. The previous run's only blocking failure was the known-flaky `[sig-auth][Feature:SCC][Early] should not have pod creation failures during install`, caused by a `catalogd-controller-manager` SCC propagation race in `openshift-catalogd` — not an MCO component.

**[e2e-gcp-op-part1 (latest run)](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/view/gs/prow-artifact-archive/pr-logs/pull/openshift_machine-config-operator/5724/pull-ci-openshift-machine-config-operator-main-e2e-gcp-op-part1/2074845673873739776)** — `TestRunShared/MCD_Config_Drift/forcefile_recovery` timed out waiting 5 minutes for node recovery after writing the forcefile; the cleanup exec then got `connection refused` on kubelet port 10250, i.e. the node was still mid-reboot when the timeout hit. This is a pre-existing flake: [CI search](https://search.dptools.openshift.org/?search=FAIL%3A+TestRunShared%2FMCD_Config_Drift%2Fforcefile_recovery&maxAge=336h&type=build-log&name=machine-config) shows the same subtest failing on #4878 and #6253 within the last two weeks. This PR only changes KubeletConfig CR validation; the config-drift test involves no KubeletConfig, and its four sibling subtests all passed. Note the previous part1 run's test step actually **passed** (`finished.json: SUCCESS`) — that job was only marked failed because the `gather-extra` artifact-collection post-step lost API server connectivity.
